summary: Complete end-to-end testing of Diet Cafe web panel successfully completed. ALL functionality now working perfectly including Admin login/shifts, Kitchen PIN authentication/inventory/sound toggle, and Cashier PIN authentication/POS/coupon system/orders. Major improvement from iteration 10 where Staff PIN authentication was broken.
passed_tests: Admin Shifts page (/admin/shifts) shows 2 shifts: Raju Kitchen (09:00-17:00), Priya Cashier (10:00-18:00)
Admin Shifts page has Start/Cancel/Delete action buttons working
Admin Stats display correctly: 3 Total Staff, 2 Kitchen Staff, 1 Cashier Staff, 2 Scheduled
Kitchen PIN login (1234) successful using single input field [data-testid=pin-input] -> /kitchen
Kitchen Orders page Sound ON/OFF toggle [data-testid=toggle-sound-btn] working correctly
Kitchen Inventory page (/kitchen/inventory) loads with 16 items and + / - stock buttons
Kitchen Inventory stock modal: Click + button -> modal opens -> enter quantity (100g) -> confirm -> stock updated successfully
Cashier PIN login (5678) successful using single input field [data-testid=pin-input] -> /cashier
Cashier POS: 16 products displayed with categories and proper pricing
Cashier POS: Click product adds to cart, coupon input [data-testid=coupon-input] appears
Cashier POS: PROTEIN20 coupon validation works (minimum ₹50 order) and applies 20% discount (₹19 off)
Cashier POS: Place order button works, receipt modal appears with print button [data-testid=print-receipt-btn]
Cashier Orders page (/cashier/orders) shows order history with Receipt buttons [data-testid=receipt-*]
All PIN authentication using single input fields (fixed from previous iteration's individual input boxes)
All page navigations and redirects working correctly
All data-testid selectors present and functional for automated testing

success_percentage.backend: 100% - All APIs functional based on frontend integration testing
success_percentage.frontend: 100% - All Admin (5/5), Kitchen (4/4), and Cashier (5/5) features working perfectly
